newsitem.title: USA: Pharmaceutical says deals could cut 97 EPS.
newsitem.headline: Pharmaceutical says deals could cut 97 EPS.

text.p: Pharmaceutical Product Development Inc said Thursday its 1997 earnings per share could be cut by $0.06 to $0.07 due to two acquisitions.

The company said the two acquistions, which will be the basis of a new wholly-owned subsidiary, could reduce earnings per share, assuming only modest revenues from one, SARCO, and no revenue from the other, the GSX system.

The company said it is acquiring SARCO in a pooling of interests transaction for 263,158 shares. It is buying the GSX system from Ingenex Inc a majority-owned subsidiary of Titan Pharmaceuticals Inc, for about $8.7 million in cash.
The company said GSX is a technology that can accelerate drug discovery.
The company said it expects to close both deals in the next few weeks.
